answers.mission: Advise whether a rental tool may be used.
answers.business_goal: Reduce unsafe use; do not infer business lift from owner preference.
answers.available_choices: Recommend use, withhold use, or ask for missing information.
answers.target_behavior: Require a current inspection and no reported damage; ask when either is unknown.
answers.decision_inputs: Tool, current inspection status and reported damage before use. Later incident counts are outcomes.
answers.success_and_harm: Record later incidents separately over 30 days. Owner preference is not independent safety evidence.
